blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting, you need simple, everyday English.

In this lesson, you learn five useful words: meeting, call, link, camera, and mute. You also practise short, natural sentences. For example: "The meeting is at 10." or "Please turn on your camera."

Go slowly — one step at a time. You do not need long words. Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow. You can do it!

items.q: What does IT support at Czarnikow?
options: Every office, from London to São Paulo
items.why: "IT supports every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo."

items.q: How many useful words does the lesson teach?
items.why: "you learn five useful words: meeting, call, link, camera, and mute."

items.q: What kind of English do you need with the help desk?
items.why: "you need simple, everyday English."

items.q: The text says "Go slowly — one step at a time." This suggests that the author…
options: wants you to skip the practice
wants you to feel calm and not rush
thinks the lesson is too easy
items.why: Inferência: o tom é encorajador — ir devagar é para você não se sentir pressionado.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: English is only for the London team
small IT habits do not matter
good habits now can stop big problems later
you must use long words to sound good
items.why: Inferência: "Small IT habits today save big problems tomorrow."

blocks.instruction: Ouça James marcando uma reunião online. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, this is James from IT. I want to set up a short online meeting with you. It is a good time to talk about your new laptop.

The meeting is at 10 tomorrow morning. Please write it down: at 10, not at 11. It is a video call, so please turn on your camera when you join. I am sending the link now — you can find it in the email. Just click the link at ten, and you are in. It is very easy.

One small thing. When you join, your microphone is on mute. That is normal. Do not worry. When you want to speak, click the button and turn the mute off. If you cannot hear me, check your camera and your sound first. Then send me a quick message.

The call is short, only fifteen minutes. If you have a problem with the link, send me a message or call the help desk. We are a small IT team, but we are here to help you. We answer fast.

See you at 10. Have a good day, and thank you!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What time is the meeting?
items.why: "The meeting is at 10 tomorrow morning."

items.q: What does James ask you to do when you join?
items.why: "please turn on your camera when you join."

items.q: Where can you find the link?
items.why: "I am sending the link now — you can find it in the email."

items.q: James says your microphone is on mute when you join. This means that, at the start, you…
options: cannot be heard until you turn the mute off
items.why: Inferência: no mudo, os outros não te ouvem até você tirar o mute.

items.q: From what James says, how does he sound?
items.why: Inferência: ele dá instruções simples e diz "We are here to help."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We have a team meeting at 10." A meeting is…
options: a time when people come together to talk
items.why: Meeting = reunião: quando pessoas se juntam para conversar.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I cannot join now. Can we have a video ___ at 3?"
items.why: Call = ligação / chamada — "video call" é uma chamada de vídeo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Click the ___ in the email to open the meeting."
items.why: Link = link: você clica nele para entrar na reunião.

items.q: "Please turn on your camera." A camera lets people…
items.why: Camera = câmera: mostra você na tela para os outros.

items.q: "You are on mute, so we can't hear you." Mute means your microphone is…
options: off, so no one hears you
items.why: Mute = mudo / silenciar: o microfone está desligado e ninguém te ouve.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples de reuniões online e do help desk. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Let's set up a meeting for tomorrow." To set up means to…
items.why: Set up = marcar / organizar uma reunião.

items.q: "Please turn on your camera." To turn on means to…
options: make it work / switch it on
items.why: Turn on = ligar / ativar.

items.q: "Click the link to join the call." To join means to…
items.why: Join = entrar na reunião / chamada.

items.q: "I can't hear you. Can you speak up?" To speak up means to…
items.why: Speak up = falar mais alto.

items.q: "If you have a problem, reach out to the help desk." To reach out means to…
items.why: Reach out = entrar em contato para pedir ajuda.
